# Vivid Engine Solutions

> Locally owned web and application development company based in Tomball, Texas, serving small and mid-sized businesses across Southeast Texas and Southwest Louisiana, from the Houston area to Lafayette, Louisiana. Custom websites, mobile apps and business software, hosting, security and maintenance, domain leasing, Square POS, client CRM portals, local SEO and Google Ads. In-person consultations.

## Contact
- Address: 410 Chestnut Business Parkway Dr, Tomball, TX 77375
- Office phone: 281-826-4068

- Email: info@vividenginesolutions.com

## Key facts
- Website builds (one-time): Starter $999 (up to 5 pages); Launch $1,500 (up to 10 pages, blog, gallery); Full Engine custom web or Google Play app with client portal, from $3,500, quoted after consultation.
- Monthly care (separate from the build): Basic Care $49/month (hosting, SSL, security updates, daily backups, uptime monitoring); Turnkey Care $99/month (adds one domain, site assistant, up to 1 hour of edits, monthly report, priority support).
- Add-ons: business email $6/user/month; extra page $150; copywriting $99/page; logo and brand kit $299; online booking with Google Calendar sync $299 setup; online payments or small store from $499; custom Square POS from $1,500; custom CRM from $2,500; installable app with Google Play listing from $1,500; site assistant chat $29/month; local SEO growth $249/month; Google Ads management $299/month plus ad spend; rush delivery +25%.
- Domain leasing: $9.95/month including registration, DNS, SSL and renewals. Leasing does not transfer domain ownership.
- Every project gets a written quote before work starts. Applicable sales tax is calculated at checkout.
- Typical small business websites launch in 2 to 4 weeks. Larger software projects take longer; scope and timing are agreed in advance.
- Response: same business day for inquiries before 4 pm; otherwise the next business day.

## Service area
- Houston area: Tomball and surrounding communities.
- Southeast Texas: Beaumont, Port Arthur, Orange, Nederland, Groves, Port Neches, Lumberton, Vidor.
- Southwest Louisiana: Lake Charles, Sulphur, Westlake, Moss Bluff, Vinton, DeQuincy, through Lafayette.
- Remote clients outside the region.
